raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Sr AI/ML Engineer
CGI, Bangalore Jan 2024 – Jun 2025
Roles & Responsibilities:
Designed and deployed a real-time fraud detection engine using Python, Scikit-learn, Apache Spark, improving detection precision by 25% and reducing manual investigations by 40%

Improved fraud detection accuracy by 20% through ensemble ML models (XGBoost, Neural Networks); modernized deployment with Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, reducing fraud losses and accelerating releases
Built a BERT-based NLP model integrated into CGI’s PULSE platform to classify 165K+ complaints, reducing routing time by 70% and enabling voice-to-text complaint handling.
Built a GPT-powered assistant using RAG architecture, combining vector search (Azure AI Search) with GPT to deliver accurate, context-driven answers from enterprise knowledge bases, reducing document search time
Sr AI/ML Engineer
TRIANZ, Bangalore May 2023 – Nov 2023
Roles & Responsibilities:
Created ML-OCR pipeline (Tesseract, LayoutLM, Azure Cognitive Services) with UiPath RPA, achieving 85% automation in invoice extraction and reducing manual entry by 60%.
